_comment: Known EXCHANGE / custodian deposit-wallet LABELS for crypto counterparty grading (scripts/webpivot/crypto_balance.py --counterparties, pivot_routes crypto.counterparties, urlscan identifier wallet.*). An address listed here is rung_class wallet.exchange (neighbour) — collected, never attributed as operator-owned. RULE 1: labels and public hot-wallet addresses only; NEVER case data, NEVER victim deposit addresses discovered in an investigation. Seed labels are public exchange brand names; address keys may be added later as bare sibling keys under this file's top-level 'known_addresses' object (no empty entries/values group — the reference-layer gate forbids empty membership lists).

labels._comment: Human-readable exchange/custodian labels recognised when a counterparty row carries a matching tag from an explorer (e.g. 'binance', 'coinbase'). Matching is case-insensitive substring on the label field.

known_addresses._comment: Optional known exchange deposit addresses as a FLAT object: {"bc1q…": {"label": "binance", "coin": "btc"}, …}. Intentionally has no keys today (RULE 1 — no case data). Add only publicly documented exchange hot/cold wallets. Consumers treat missing/empty known_addresses as 'no address hits'.
